verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.airbyte.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured description of the docs (airbyte-probe-1). Airbyte also publishes agent-oriented documentation, including an AI-agents concepts section and MCP server docs aimed at Claude, Cursor and similar agents (airbyte-docs-48, airbyte-docs-6, airbyte-docs-39). Missing for 10: evidence of llms.txt depth or completeness (e.g. an llms-full.txt or per-page markdown), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully consuming the docs.
